name: Holiday Parties & Company Celebrations
shortDescription: Company holiday parties, year-end dinners, and client celebrations for 20–180 guests, with private dining, rooftop patio, custom food and beverage, event coordination, and larger venue options in Little Italy.

seoTitle: Holiday Party Venue San Diego | Company Celebrations | Coco Maya
seoDescription: Plan a company holiday party or year-end celebration at Coco Maya in Little Italy, San Diego. Private dining, patio, custom menus, and full-venue options.
intro: Coco Maya hosts company holiday parties, year-end dinners, team celebrations, and client gatherings in Little Italy for groups from approximately 20 guests up to 180 guests depending on the space and format.

The setting can be matched to the event: a more focused private dining experience, an elevated patio gathering, or a larger venue configuration when the group needs room for cocktails, dinner, remarks, recognition, and social time in one place.

Food and beverage can be planned around seated dinners, reception-style service, or a hybrid format. The event team can also coordinate dietary requirements, timing, seating, basic AV needs, decor or outside-vendor logistics, and centralized company billing before the event.

highlights.label: 20–180 Guest Options
highlights.detail: Coco Maya can scale from a planned company dinner to a larger full-venue celebration. The right configuration depends on headcount, service style, and how much of the evening needs to be programmed.

highlights.label: Private Dining & Rooftop Options
highlights.detail: Choose a more focused indoor dinner, a social patio gathering, or a larger venue configuration depending on whether the priority is conversation, cocktails, presentations, or a full celebration.

highlights.label: Custom Food & Beverage
highlights.detail: Menus and drink packages can be planned around seated dinners, cocktail-style gatherings, or a mix of both, with dietary requirements addressed during planning.

highlights.label: AV, Decor & Vendor Coordination
highlights.detail: For leadership remarks, recognition, presentations, florals, photography, or outside vendors, share those requirements early so the space and service timeline can be built around them.

highlights.label: Company Billing & Event Coordination
highlights.detail: Larger company gatherings can use centralized billing and a single event-planning path instead of managing multiple restaurant reservations, tabs, and timing separately.

faqs.question: Can Coco Maya host a company holiday party in San Diego?
faqs.answer: Yes. Coco Maya hosts company holiday parties, year-end dinners, team celebrations, and client gatherings in Little Italy, with private dining, patio, and larger venue options based on the size and format of the event.

faqs.question: How many guests can Coco Maya accommodate for a holiday party?
faqs.answer: Private-event configurations can accommodate groups from approximately 20 guests up to 180 guests for a full-venue event. The best space depends on your headcount, service style, and preferred setup.

faqs.question: Can we host a holiday dinner instead of a cocktail-style party?
faqs.answer: Yes. Holiday events can be planned around a seated dinner, a more social food-and-drink format, or a combination of both. Share the experience you want when you inquire so the team can recommend the right setup.

faqs.question: Can Coco Maya accommodate dietary restrictions for a company event?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dietary needs can be considered when planning the event menu. Include any known requirements with your inquiry so they can be incorporated into the proposal and menu planning.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we inquire about a holiday party?
faqs.answer: Earlier is better for preferred November and December dates, especially for larger groups and weekend events. Availability varies, so send your date and expected headcount as soon as your planning window is established.
